description: Campaign 025 game-board feedback consistency. Orchestrator owns the shared layers (theme, platform, kit, shell, game chrome, docs, scripts); eight packets own disjoint game-module directories and must report shared-file needs instead of editing them.

parallelPackets.objective: Apply the shared verdict language and animated score read-outs to attention-sustained-vigilance, attention-target-count without touching mechanics.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Each game presents verdicts through fill + boundary/shape + glyph, keeps the prompt visible, derives feedback from the reducer outcome, animates score changes, and keeps every existing testID; the game unit suites pass unmodified.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/games/attention-sustained-vigilance src/games/attention-target-count
